race.comment: KING OF THE SEA (1) exciting import resuming for his second Australian campaign. Savaged the line in his three starts last prep and worth noting J Mac takes the reins here. Fitted with the two searching trials over 1000m and adept in all conditions. Can get the better of these with the 60.5kg. THE CREATOR (2) has been about the mark all campaign and expect to see him race a touch closer here. Went back from the draw and kept finding through the line with a game fourth over 1600m at this track with the apprentice aboard. Tommy Berry hops aboard and expected to go close. PUNTIN (9) big improver at his third run back when he went out quickly before tiring late to run third over this course and distance. Near his top now and worth plenty of thought. COSMEENA (10) will roll forward and give plenty of cheek at the good odds.
